classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Retrieve UniProt-reviewed representative sequences for NAD(P)HX repair proteins annotated with ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity (GO:0070204) and NADPHX epimerase activity (GO:0097619), perform biochemical composition and motif analysis on each set, generate ESM3 embeddings and confidence scores for representativeness scoring, and produce two ranked candidate lists covering both enzymatic arms of the NAD(P)HX repair pathway.
assumptions: GO:0070204 is assumed to encode ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity (CARKD/NAXD family); if retrieval returns zero results the correct term ID may differ and should be retried.
GO:0097619 is assumed to encode NADPHX epimerase activity (NAXE family); same caveat applies.
Only Swiss-Prot reviewed entries are retrieved to maximize annotation quality; IEA evidence codes are excluded to reduce noise.
sequence_analysis representative_sequences output is a list of objects each containing a 'sequence' string field usable by ESM3.
ESM3 embedding and structure tracks provide per-sequence confidence scores that inform representativeness ranking via rank_designs.

Dehydratase and epimerase sequences are ranked in separate rank_designs nodes because they represent distinct enzymatic activities that act sequentially in the NAD(P)HX repair pathway; both ranked lists together describe the full pathway.
max_sequences is capped at 200 per GO term to keep retrieval runtime practical.
pH 7.4 is used as the physiological default for charge-state calculations in sequence_analysis.
max_parallel 4 for ESM3 foreach is conservative to avoid GPU memory contention; raise if more GPUs are available.
missing_inputs: Confirmation of exact GO term IDs; GO:0070204 and GO:0097619 are assumed from biological knowledge and should be verified against the QuickGO browser if retrieval yields empty results.
Target organism or taxonomic scope; defaulting to all reviewed UniProt entries across all taxa.
Preferred ranking criteria or scoring weights; using rank_designs defaults.
Desired final top-k per activity; defaulting to top_k=10.

success_criteria.ranked_dehydratase_candidates: Top-10 ranked representative sequences for ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity with biochemical metrics and ESM3 confidence scores in ranked_dehydratase.tsv
success_criteria.ranked_epimerase_candidates: Top-10 ranked representative sequences for NADPHX epimerase activity with biochemical metrics and ESM3 confidence scores in ranked_epimerase.tsv
success_criteria.literature_context: Literature evidence summarizing NAD(P)HX metabolite damage repair biology for scientific interpretation of ranked candidates
success_criteria.artifacts: FASTA files, sequence-analysis JSONs, and ranked TSV/JSON files for both enzymatic activities available for downstream use

inputs.query: NAD(P)HX repair enzyme ADP-dependent dehydratase epimerase metabolite damage NAXD NAXE
